mapper.select: SELECT cg.CORP_GR AS corpGr , TO_CHAR(cg.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS trYmd , cg.TR_CD AS trCd , cg.FUND_CD AS fundCd , cg.JM_CD AS jmCd , cg.BUY_DATE AS buyDate , cg.SEQ_NO AS seqNo , cg.TR_CO_CD AS trCoCd , cg.AEKM AS aekm , cg.DANGA AS danga , cg.TR_AEK AS trAek , cg.SUSU AS susu , TO_CHAR(cg.SUDO_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sudoYmd , cg.MK_SUIK_RT AS mkSuikRt , cg.PG_CD AS pgCd , cg.JAJUN_GB AS jajunGb , cg.CHUI_AEK AS chuiAek , cg.DANGA_GB AS dangaGb , cg.JAJUN_SAYU AS jajunSayu , cg.IJA_AEKM AS ijaAekm , cj.CJ_NM AS cjNm , ia.FUND_NM AS fundNm , 1 AS pVisible FROM SCT0CG cg LEFT OUTER JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.CORP_GR = cg.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = cg.FUND_CD , SCM0CJ cj WHERE cg.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND (TRUNC(cg.TR_YMD) >= TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{trYmd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') OR TRUNC(cg.SUDO_YMD) = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{trYmd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD')) AND cg.TR_CD LIKE 'J%' AND cj.CORP_GR = cg.CORP_GR AND cj.JM_CD = cg.JM_CD ORDER BY cg.TR_YMD ASC , cg.FUND_CD ASC , cg.JM_CD ASC
